note: Per-family facts the K0 gates (tools/k0-gates.py) read; the producer never self-declares them in the manifest it writes. The shipped 040/060 families only. Boot-slice budget: a disk kernel must fit the UNIX_Boot slice less 10240 B (boot1, two IBLKs, boot2): 2086912 B on a 2 MiB slice, 10475520 B on a 10 MiB slice.

control.name: candidate-3
control.why: The rollback and diff reference, never rebuilt. A path under amix-040-060-port/ resolves in the port checkout ($PORT, tools/k0-gates.py find_port).

scan060.normalisation: candidate lines only; address column dropped; PC-relative targets '@(<hex> <SYM>)' reduced to '@(<SYM>)'; sorted. A newer scan060.py cannot move the gate: the set is pinned by this sha.
scan060.why: The 55 inherited candidates are stock movep/cas2/cmp2/64-bit-mul sites in stock and FPSP code that candidate-3 already carries to a real 060; they are not a driver-line finding. If one is ever shown to execute on silicon, that is a port issue, not a gate change.

K060.note: candidate-3's family: the control itself (card 1 unit 6). Its driver objects are the c3 build's; the whole-kernel set IS the control's.
K060.wd7_exempt: the frozen control candidate-3: proven on the A4000T without a probe before W-D7 existed; never rebuilt. Every later family carries W-D7.

KD060-Z.note: The shipped Z3660 060 family: driver objects z3660_040.o 6ed4ef8d (refuses READ/WRITE with blocks x bs > nbyte, counter z3660_short_n), zz9000_040.o 40d3b16c (-DZZ9K_MONSW, the blitter register cache), monsw.o 59c76b95, parinit_monsw.o 4942fb49, z3660eth_040.o a1f49c54, dd_order040.o 5a3a7a5d; /dev/monsw on cdevsw row 52; the W-D7 probe 6a5e077e; sddevsize's never-opened default 1234567 -> 0x3FFFFF (tools/kernel-sddevsize-inject.py).

spl.why: Under -traditional sys/types.h erases volatile and gcc drops the spl()/splx() asms. G1 = the macro dump must not define volatile empty; G2 = every spl-calling function writes %sr. Paths are relative to --objects-dir (the port build dir); includes are the relink scripts' own; cflags_env resolves beside the port checkout unless $GCA is set.

zz9000_040.o.note: -DZZ9K_MONSW: the driver switches through monsw_set(); its own IPL bracket is gone, so G2 reads 0 sites / 0 %sr writes by design (the bracket lives in monsw.o).
